message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need | How it works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Plus 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile. Turn the top card over to start the discard pile. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score **1,000 points** (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are tallied at the end of each round. | | **Gameplay** | 1. Play proceeds clockwise (unless a Reverse changes direction). 2. On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches the discard pile’s **color**, **number**, or **action**. 3. If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color cards; otherwise, the opponent can challenge.) | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, the round ends. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, action cards = 20, Wild = 50. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. If the winner reaches or exceeds the target (e.g., 1,000), the game ends. | | **Special Rules** | • **UNO Call** – When you have one card left, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so results in a penalty: draw two cards.
• **Challenge** – If a player plays a Wild Draw Four but you suspect they had a playable color card, you can challenge. If you’re right, the challenger draws four cards; if wrong, you draw six. | | **Variations** | Many house rules exist: “Stacking” (draw two or four can be countered by another of the same type), “No Draw” (players must play a card or pass), “Card‑in‑Hand” (players can play any card from hand, not just the top of the discard pile), etc. Clarify before starting. | --- ### Quick Play‑through 1. **Setup**: Shuffle, deal 7 cards each, flip top card to start discard pile. 2. **Turn**: - Match color/number/action or play a Wild. - If you can’t, draw one card. - If you draw a playable card, you may play it immediately. 3. **UNO**: Say “UNO” when you’re down to one card. 4. **Finish**: When someone discards their last card, tally points. 5. **Repeat** until a player reaches the target score. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
